observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a transmission housing with a torque converter visible inside, mounted on a stand. The housing has bolt holes and fluid lines attached.
Photo 1 shows the side of the same transmission housing, with visible wear, red paint marks, and a white label with red text (partially obscured).
Photo 2 shows the internal components of the transmission: the input shaft, clutch plate, and torque converter. The housing is open, revealing the internal gears and bearings.
All photos show a used, disassembled transmission unit on a dirt ground, with no visible branding or model markings on the housing or internal parts.
The seller claims it is a 'Complete gearbox M272'.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model number on the housing or internal components in any photo. The label in photo 1 is too blurry to read.

risks.risk: The gearbox may not be M272 as claimed, or may be damaged internally (e.g., worn gears, seized bearings).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label or casting number on the housing, or a video showing the internal components being rotated or tested.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used gearbox without model verification, which may be lower than M272-specific parts.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., seized, leaking, or missing components).
risks.proof: A video showing the input shaft rotating freely, or a close-up of the fluid level and condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, since functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The gearbox may not be complete (e.g., missing clutch assembly, solenoids, or sensors).
risks.proof: A photo or video showing all components included in the 'complete' set, including the clutch assembly and any sensors or solenoids.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the label or casting number on the transmission housing.
Video showing the input shaft rotating freely and fluid level.
Photo or video showing all components included in the 'complete' set.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
